answer: The cipher test I would run is Stamped calligrapher society membership with calligraphy society attestation: a membership the society kept across years of scribes, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the timber of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the walnut of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
